'''Natchgas''' was a type of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] produced by [[Bio-converter power generator/Legends|bio-converter power generators]], which created it by converting liquid sludge consisting of animal and municipal waste that was fed into the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] by underground pipes. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> bio-converter power generators were used in the homes of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], including the [[Skywalker home/Legends|Skywalker home]] in [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]],<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Natchgas was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
